h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amaravati

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amaravati

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Amaravati

c: Amaravati is being built as the capital region of Andhra Pradesh, on the banks of the Krishna near Vijayawada and Guntur. That means many sites here are new: government buildings, institutional campuses and planned residential areas. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Amaravati for exactly this kind of project, where the open gym can be planned into the site from the first drawing.

Planning early saves money. If the open gym is shown on the master plan, the contractor can lay a level, drained base and run lighting to it while other work is under way. Send us the plot plan and the number of people likely to use it, and we will send a layout drawing with each machine and its clear space marked. The region is hot and humid for most of the year, with heavy rain in the monsoon, so we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts. We make everything at our Vasai factory and deliver by road.

richText.heading: Building an open gym into a new campus

c: For a new institutional campus, we usually suggest a core set that covers the whole body and can be extended later. The
gives eight stations on one frame for a busy campus. A
Leg Press Cum Fun Walker Cum Seating Twister

adds three more exercises on a single base. Leave space in the plan for more stations, since each one is installed independently. Ask your architect to run the main walking path past the gym so people see it every day.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 540 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you work from a master plan or architect's drawing?
items.a: Yes. Share the plot plan and we will add the outdoor gym to it with each station and its clear space marked. Your architect can then fit it with paths and lighting.

items.q: How is equipment delivered to Amaravati?
items.a: We manufacture it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and send it by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the south installs it on the prepared base.

items.q: Can we add more machines later?
items.a: Yes. Each station stands on its own grouted or self-standing base, so new machines can be added without disturbing the ones already installed.
